This chain of indications implies that Benzoyl Peroxide may contribute to the development of Occupational Dermatitis by inducing contact dermatitis, which can lead to chronic inflammation and irritation. The strength of this relationship is supported by the final score of 0.5586, indicating a moderate level of confidence in the pathway.
